name: qa-fuzz-testing
description: Coverage-guided fuzzing with libFuzzer, AFL++, cargo-fuzz, Go native fuzzing, Atheris and Jazzer, plus sanitizer crash triage. Covers fuzzer choice, corpus management, sanitizer integration, and ASan / UBSan / MSan crash classification with bulk triage. A builder agent (fuzz-target-author) scaffolds a fuzz harness from a function signature. Binary and system-level fuzzing, distinct from qa-property-based and qa-api-testing/schemathesis-fuzzing.
